voice_configs.tts_description: He sounds like a gentle and experienced guide.
She sounds like a gentle and nurturing companion.

segments.speaker: Old Man
segments.line: I've heard the stories, my love. The fountain of youth is hidden deep within these woods.

segments.speaker: Old Woman
segments.line: We've been searching for so long, my dear. I fear we may never find it.

segments.speaker: Old Man
segments.line: Stay close, my love. I don't like this one bit.

segments.speaker: Old Man
segments.line: We're getting close, my love. I can feel it.

segments.speaker: Old Woman
segments.line: But at what cost? We've been walking for days, and I'm not sure how much longer I can go on.

segments.speaker: Old Man
segments.line: Hold on to me, my love! I've got you!

segments.speaker: Old Woman
segments.line: I'm slipping! Oh, dear God, I'm slipping!

segments.speaker: Old Man
segments.line: We did it, my love. We found it.

segments.speaker: Old Woman
segments.line: But at what cost? We've lost so much, and gained so little.
